_comment_collector: Master controls for the main collector and how it processes Pavlov logs and state.

collector._comment_enabled: Master switch for the collector section.
collector._comment_historical_logs: Allow the collector to process older/historical Pavlov log files.
collector._comment_active_logs: Allow the collector to process currently active Pavlov log files.
collector._comment_stats_logs: Enable processing of Pavlov stats files.
collector._comment_rotate_active_logs: Allow active logs to be rotated when supported by the collector.
collector._comment_processing_state: Save processing state so files and offsets can be tracked between runs.
collector._comment_duplicate_detection: Prevent already-processed events from being counted more than once.

_comment_players: Controls collection and storage of player identity, stats, settings, network data and indexes.

players._comment_enabled: Master switch for all player-related collection.

identity._comment_enabled: Master switch for player identity tracking.
identity._comment_product_id: Store the Pavlov ProductID used as the primary player key.
identity._comment_unique_id: Store the player's platform/Pavlov UniqueID when available.
identity._comment_current_name: Store the player's most recently observed name.
identity._comment_first_seen: Store when the player was first observed.
identity._comment_last_seen: Store when the player was most recently observed.

players._comment_connections: Player connect/disconnect and server history tracking.

connections._comment_enabled: Master switch for player connection tracking.
connections._comment_times_connected: Maintain a count of how many times each player has connected.
connections._comment_connection_history: Keep historical connection records for each player.
connections._comment_server_history: Track which configured Pavlov servers each player has used.

players._comment_settings: Player client/settings data observed from Pavlov logs.

settings._comment_enabled: Master switch for player settings tracking.
settings._comment_right_handed: Track whether the player uses right-handed controls.
settings._comment_vstock: Track the player's virtual-stock setting when available.
settings._comment_player_height: Track the player height value when exposed by Pavlov.
settings._comment_client_platform: Track the player's client platform when available.

stats._comment_enabled: Master switch for player statistic tracking.
stats._comment_bot_kills: Track kills involving bots when detected.
stats._comment_unverified_team_kills: Track suspected/unverified teamkills when full verification is unavailable.
stats._comment_times_connected: Include connection count in player stats.

weapons._comment_weapon_kills: Track kills made with each weapon/item.
weapons._comment_favorite_weapon: Calculate/store the player's most-used kill weapon.
weapons._comment_favorite_weapon_kills: Store the number of kills with the favorite weapon.
weapons._comment_total_weapon_kills: Store total kills represented by weapon statistics.
weapons._comment_weapon_source: Track where weapon/item identification came from when available.

players._comment_network: Hashed IP history and network enrichment for players.

network._comment_enabled: Master switch for player network tracking.
network._comment_ip_hash: Store a keyed hash of observed player IP addresses.
network._comment_ip_history: Track multiple hashed IPs previously used by the player.
network._comment_known_ip_count: Maintain a count of known IP hashes associated with the player.
network._comment_network_enrichment: Enable enrichment of observed network/IP data.
network._comment_network_type: Store detected network type when available.
network._comment_tor: Store Tor detection result when provided by the enrichment source.
network._comment_confidence: Store confidence information associated with network/risk results.
network._comment_lookup_source: Store which service/source produced the network enrichment.

status._comment_enabled: Master switch for player status flags.
status._comment_admin: Track whether the player is recognized as an admin.
status._comment_banned: Track whether the player is currently recognized as banned.

players._comment_history: Historical changes to important player data.

history._comment_network_changes: Log changes to enriched network information.
history._comment_settings_changes: Log changes to tracked player settings.

players._comment_indexes: Lookup indexes used for fast player searches and correlation.

indexes._comment_by_name: Maintain player-name to ProductID lookup index.
indexes._comment_by_unique_id: Maintain UniqueID to ProductID lookup index.
indexes._comment_by_ip_hash: Maintain IP-hash to ProductID correlation index.

_comment_server_data: Server configuration, runtime, admin, ban and service metadata.

server_data._comment_platform: Track whether the server is PCVR, Shack or auto-detected.
server_data._comment_game_ini: Parse and store relevant Game.ini configuration.
server_data._comment_http_events: Track relevant HTTP/backend errors seen in server logs.
server_data._comment_service_info: Track the systemd service associated with each Pavlov server.

matches._comment_player_stats: Store per-player statistics from match data.

maps._comment_map_id: Store map IDs such as default-map IDs or UGC IDs.
maps._comment_game_mode: Track game modes associated with maps.
maps._comment_configured_state: Track whether a map is currently configured.
maps._comment_observed_maps: Track maps seen loaded by the server.
maps._comment_modio: Enrich UGC maps with mod.io information.

_comment_mods: Configured and observed Pavlov mod tracking.

mods._comment_configured_mods: Track mods configured for the server.
mods._comment_configured_vs_observed: Compare configured mods against mods observed at runtime.

_comment_custom_content: Custom guns, items and map-provided content.

custom_content._comment_custom_guns: Track custom guns observed on servers/maps.
custom_content._comment_loot_meshes: Track custom loot/item mesh references when detected.

_comment_rcon: RCON connection, authentication, command and host tracking.

rcon._comment_enabled: Master switch for RCON data collection.
rcon._comment_connections: Track RCON connections and connection history.
rcon._comment_known_hosts: Track hosts that successfully connect to RCON.
rcon._comment_failed_hosts: Track hosts that fail RCON authentication.
rcon._comment_ip_hash: Hash RCON source IPs before persistence.
rcon._comment_network_enrichment: Perform network enrichment for RCON source addresses.
rcon._comment_player_correlation: Compare RCON IP hashes against known player IP hashes.

rcon_bridge._comment_enabled: Master switch for the RCON/custom-command bridge.
rcon_bridge._comment_input_files: Allow IN-*.json trigger files to be processed.
rcon_bridge._comment_output_files: Allow OUT-*.json response files to be written.
rcon_bridge._comment_ppapi_trigger: Allow the Pavlov Public API updater file trigger.
rcon_bridge._comment_rcon_resource_trigger: Allow the RCON resource refresh file trigger.

rcon_loop._comment_enabled: Master switch for the RCON loop system.
rcon_loop._comment_serverinfo: Request ServerInfo during each loop iteration.
rcon_loop._comment_inspectall: Request InspectAll during each loop iteration.
rcon_loop._comment_output: Write the latest loop results to loopOutput.json.
rcon_loop._comment_control_helper: Enable helper/control support for creating/removing loopData.json.

_comment_ssh: SSH security monitoring and automatic blocking.

ssh._comment_player_correlation: Compare SSH source IP hashes against player IP hashes.
ssh._comment_auto_block: Allow automatic firewall blocking after configured thresholds.
ssh._comment_private_raw_ip_storage: Allow raw SSH IPs to be stored only in the designated private data location.

ddos._comment_host_history: Maintain historical traffic information by hashed source.
ddos._comment_player_correlation: Check source IP hashes against players.
ddos._comment_rcon_correlation: Check source IP hashes against RCON activity.
ddos._comment_ssh_correlation: Check source IP hashes against SSH activity.

_comment_pavlov_public_api: Pavlov public server API updater and enrichment.

pavlov_public_api._comment_enabled: Master switch for Pavlov public API data.
pavlov_public_api._comment_updater: Enable the Pavlov public API updater.
pavlov_public_api._comment_manual_update: Allow manual execution of the updater.
pavlov_public_api._comment_file_trigger: Allow file-trigger execution of the updater.
pavlov_public_api._comment_server_data: Store data returned by the Pavlov public server API.

_comment_modio: Global controls for mod.io lookups and caching.

modio._comment_api_requests: Allow requests to the mod.io API.
modio._comment_cache: Allow local caching of mod.io responses.

_comment_admins: Admin identity, session-time tracking, logging and moderation alerts.

tracking._comment_enabled: Master switch for admin tracking data.
tracking._comment_admin_status: Track whether known players are admins.
tracking._comment_admin_time: Calculate total time admins spend online.
tracking._comment_admin_server_time: Calculate admin time separately for each Pavlov server.

logs._comment_admin_actions: Store admin actions when an action source/parser is available.
logs._comment_future_external_admin_log_inges: Reserve support for external/admin-tool log ingestion not yet implemented.

notifications._comment_no_admin_online: Alert when players are online but no known admin is present.
notifications._comment_negative_player_score: Alert when a player's score drops below the configured threshold.
notifications._comment_multiple_teamkills: Alert when a player reaches the configured teamkill threshold.
notifications._comment_ping_admin_role: Ping the configured Discord admin role when alerts are sent.
notifications._comment_response_tracking: Track whether admins respond to alerts.

response_tracking._comment_enabled: Master switch for admin alert-response tracking.
response_tracking._comment_track_admin_join: Track an admin joining after an alert.
response_tracking._comment_track_response_time: Calculate how long after the alert the admin joined.
response_tracking._comment_track_expired_alerts: Record alerts that receive no admin response before the response window expires.

discord_bot._comment_enabled: Master switch for the Discord bot.

permissions._comment_enabled: Master switch for bot permission checks.
permissions._comment_channel_restriction: Restrict bot commands to the configured control channel.

rcon._comment_enabled: Allow RCON commands through the Discord bot.
rcon._comment_admin_limited_commands: Restrict ADMIN users to the configured RCON allow-list.
rcon._comment_owner_all_commands: Allow OWNER users access to all supported RCON commands.
rcon._comment_response_embeds: Return formatted Discord embeds for RCON responses.

systemctl._comment_enabled: Enable supported systemctl actions from the bot.
systemctl._comment_enable: Allow enabling configured Pavlov services at boot.
systemctl._comment_disable: Allow disabling configured Pavlov services at boot.

discord_bot._comment_player_lookup: Read-only player lookup commands exposed through Discord.

player_lookup._comment_enabled: Master switch for player lookup commands.

discord_bot._comment_owner_commands: Higher-impact maintenance commands available through the bot.

owner_commands._comment_enabled: Master switch for OWNER maintenance commands.
owner_commands._comment_clear_pavlov_mods: Allow OWNER to run the Pavlov mod-cleaning helper.
owner_commands._comment_run_collector: Allow OWNER to manually run/start the collector.
owner_commands._comment_run_pavlov_api: Allow OWNER to manually run the Pavlov API updater.
owner_commands._comment_run_ssh_report: Allow OWNER to build/send the SSH report.

discord_bot._comment_loop_control: Discord controls for the ServerInfo/InspectAll loop.

loop_control._comment_enabled: Master switch for Discord loop controls.
loop_control._comment_start: Allow starting/creating the RCON loop control file.
loop_control._comment_stop: Allow stopping the loop by deleting its control file.

_comment_data_tools: Data deletion, export and backup tools.

data_tools._comment_enabled: Master switch for collector data tools.
data_tools._comment_include_hash_secret_in_export: Include the IP hashing secret in portable exports so historical hashes remain correlatable after restore.

maintenance._comment_service_metadata_refresh: Refresh saved service information when maintenance/service discovery runs.

_comment_service_discovery: Discovery and storage of Pavlov systemd service information.

service_discovery._comment_discover_services: Search systemd services to find the one associated with each configured server path.
service_discovery._comment_save_commands: Save useful service commands such as start/stop/restart/status for later use.

privacy._comment_ip_hashing: Use keyed IP hashing for correlation instead of exposing raw addresses.
privacy._comment_private_player_ips: Keep raw player IP data only in designated private storage when required.
privacy._comment_private_ssh_ips: Keep raw SSH source addresses only in designated private storage when required.
privacy._comment_raw_ip_in_webhooks: Permit raw IP addresses in Discord/webhook payloads. Recommended false.
privacy._comment_raw_ip_in_ddos_records: Permit raw IP addresses in persisted DDoS/network records. Recommended false.

_comment_scripts: Top-level enable/disable switches for individual JTWP scripts.

scripts._comment_enabled: Master switch for scripted JTWP components.
scripts._comment_pavlov_api_updater: Enable the Pavlov public API updater script.
